subject: Taxes
title: Yield Farming Tax Nightmare
description: A 60-second lesson on Yield Farming Tax Nightmare.

hook.text: Yield farmers move crypto between protocols hourly chasing the best returns. Each move can trigger a taxable event.

buildup.text: Farming rewards arrive as new tokens—often from obscure protocols—with wildly fluctuating prices.

discovery.text: The IRS hasn't issued specific guidance on yield farming. Is it income? Capital gains? Both? Tax professionals disagree.

twist.text: Some yield farming rewards are in tokens that don't even have a reliable price.

climax.text: Yield farming is the ultimate stress test for tax law.

punchline.text: Thousands of taxable events per day. Yield farming broke the system.

quiz.question: Why is yield farming especially difficult to tax?
options: Thousands of events per day with unstable token prices and unclear rules
